== Notes ==
* Combine Echo and Arcane Echo to create [[echo chain]]s, allowing you to use three copies of any single skill.
* If the next skill after Arcane Echo is not a spell, this enchantment will end with no effect.
* Arcane Echo will only recharge normally if no spell was copied. If a spell was copied, the copy remains for 20 seconds, after which Arcane Echo is [[disable]]d for 20 seconds.
** Consider using [[Auspicious Incantation]] before Arcane Echo for [[energy management]], since the [[recharge time]] will not be increased.
* If used to copy a [[Skill quick reference#Skills that are replaced with other skills|spell that can copy another skill or spell]], the copy [[duration]] of that spell is used and will bypass Arcane Echo's 20-second copy duration.
** E.g., if used to copy Echo, whatever skill that is copied by the Arcane Echo version of Echo will remain as that skill for 30 seconds and then revert back to Arcane Echo.
*Arcane Echo's copying effect triggers first, before the effects of the spell that triggers it. For instance, when used to copy [[Gift of Health]], the copy is disabled by Gift of Health's effect afterwards.
{{anomaly|Arcane Echo's description omits the fact that it cannot copy itself.}}
